data.one_liner: A specialized page route allowing users to navigate back by swiping anywhere.
data.what_it_does: SwipeablePageRoute is a CupertinoPageRoute variant that lets users trigger a back navigation by swiping anywhere on the screen instead of just the edge. It also provides MorphingAppBar and MorphingSliverAppBar widgets that seamlessly animate app bar contents between pages.
use_when: You want full-screen edge swipe back navigation similar to iOS style routes.
You need smooth widget morphing animations for app bars between different screens.
You are using Go Router and want to use custom swipeable page transitions.
avoid_when: You need a standard default Material page route without custom gestures.
You do not want to manage Hero controllers or widget keys for app bar animations.
strengths: Includes morphing app bars that animate titles, actions, and backgrounds smoothly.
Compatible with Go Router via SwipeablePage.
weaknesses: Requires proper key configuration on app bar actions for correct transition animations.
Must set SwipeablePageTransitionsBuilder for TargetPlatform.iOS if using PageTransitionsTheme.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: For advanced declarative routing and deep linking code generation.

alternatives.why_pick_it: For standard declarative routing maintained by the official Flutter team.
